title: Trusted-main-only postmerge PR-comment journal receipt with independent readback
summary: Add default-denied, future-only P01+ transition publisher. After independently verified primary PR merge, main ancestry, trusted CI and fully labelled issues, write sanitized SQLite transition event and remotely persisted github-actions[bot] comment to that same merged PR, with exact readback and deduplication. No P00 backfill, no new issue/branch, no PR merge or next-phase start.
migration_notes: No user-data schema/storage changes; local ephemeral test database and future GitHub PR comment only. No historical transition record will be backdated.
